status: REJECTED FOR RELEASE: static survey-shell shadows have visible edge artifacts and cannot track gameplay edits or sun movement

benchmark.note: Six one-second FPS readings per phase after six seconds of warmup; a local comparison, not a universal performance guarantee.

prototype.status: Experimental QA only; not integrated into the release
limitations: Survey shells include openings and recesses that current reconstruction has changed.
Fixed sunlight matches the existing material shader, not the day/night sun.
Does not track player destruction, placed blocks, vegetation or provider mesh.
Reference frame is the isolated QA world; production needs explicit region-height translation.

visualReview: The candidate adds broad courtyard shading, but creates bands on the rounded tower and roof-edge halos.
The current preview still has pale photographic ground margins and approximate glass; this experiment does not resolve them.
nextStep: Test a depth pass from the actual loaded MapTile buffers after damage refresh. Match material sunlight and validate destruction, region changes, alpha-cutout foliage, frame rate and representative routes before enabling it.
